question.text: Per Regulation 22(1A) (Aug 26, 2022 amendment), what client-level consent is required for related-party transactions?

answer.text: Written consent from each client for each related-party transaction

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 22(1A): written consent of the affected client is mandatory for each related-party transaction in their portfolio. The Trap: Oral approval is insufficient; compliance sign-off alone doesn't substitute client consent. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A tests basics; XXI-B expects the 2022 amendment. Manager's Pro-Tip: Maintain signed consent forms in the client's dedicated folder — SEBI's newer Inspection templates specifically check this.
